lines: S1
Practising fast doesn't make you fast.
S1
It makes you fast at your mistakes.
S2
Every rep teaches your hands something.
S2
If the rep is sloppy, sloppy is what they learn.
S3
Here's the part most people skip.
S3
Slow down until it's clean. Ten clean reps.
S3
Then speed up a little. Still clean? Speed up again.
S4
Clean at slow speed becomes clean at full speed.
S4
Typing, guitar, a tennis serve. Same rule.
S4
What are you rushing right now?
